dialogues.speaker: Smirnov
dialogues.text: Greetings, esteemed guest. I, Smirnov, will be your bartender today. Would you like anything?

dialogues.speaker: Smirnov
dialogues.text: Milk, or Sunsettias, or even Rimecurrant jam... Hmm? Ah. I mean, these pair perfectly with Fire-Water.

dialogues.speaker: Smirnov
dialogues.text: As for our recommendation, that's what it'd be. Fire-Water. Shipped from a distillery in Novokitezh, genuine as genuine can be.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can animal claws be used to make drinks?

dialogues.speaker: Smirnov
dialogues.text: Guests ask me this question often... And I say, "Of course." My fingers are not as slender as a human's, but I assure you, they're more agile than you imagine.

dialogues.speaker: Smirnov
dialogues.text: Besides, we have paws, all the better to rest the wine bottle on... as steady as a baby is held in a mother's embrace.

dialogues.speaker: Smirnov
dialogues.text: Of course, dear guest. Do approach me if you fancy having some drinks.
